scope: Synthetic bottom-up pool cases plus one Windows 10 19041 x64 crash dump. Not a 32-bit, pre-Windows 8, timeline, or dump-byte acceptance.

comparison.scope: selected fields only; full capability acceptance remains pending

notes: Compared fields are the low 48 bits of Offset, PID, PPID, ImageFileName, thread count, handle absence, session, Wow64, second-truncated create and exit times, and the literal Disabled file column.
The go test binary that produced the compared JSONL is 44c0fec5c6dd49e9909395ff07e904bfa53cfcd8e3a432c28bdc915f75386250.
The active PsList reference has 120 processes. PsScan adds PID 408 MpCmdRun.exe, which is not on PsActiveProcessHead.
This image has no HANDLE_TABLE.HandleCount, so both sides leave Handles empty. Four session pointers are zero and stay not applicable.
The year window uses the local year at runtime. This comparison ran in 2026.
